derived: Scene 482 resolves event_anqixian11 directly; 483..488 resolve it through inherit_mission=482 because no event_anqixianNN modules exist for 12..17.
COC party is exactly [135] because BattleStageMember replaces heroes with list(target_hero) before admission.
Timeout is failure because the third mission_time value (5) is not CAMP1 (1) and the client compares battle.camp == win_camp.
official_policy: Mission admission and team selection are client-side; result settlement and drops are server-authoritative in the original game.

The legacy offline_stage.basic_city_stage_chain 1..8 rejection is a legacy reference only and is not current Main evidence. Main dispatch is fixed DEX/StoryCity/Gateway; the 482..488 family must be admitted through that actual dispatch and remains unproven here.
Area status/lock effects belong to the CityCoreA cityEffects contract and are not reproduced here; progression events are reference-only.
Namespace remains q7StoryCity; this contract does not enable Main or menu 25.
unknown: The objective-complete success trigger lives in the PvE scene asset (g58_*_pve.scn), not in cdata; only timeout failure and battle completion events are table-derivable.
mission_time[2] literal 5 is not a UnitCamp value; timeout is derived to be a failure from battle.camp == win_camp, not from a documented constant.

Client dialogue IDs 21491..21495 for clues 17..21 are preserved from cdata; their dialogue-table text still needs a static literal/source join. The clue_des text is available from decompiled puzzle_room_clue and must not be dropped.
Original server reward/drop rule for MAIN_MISSION scenes is not present in client tables; city_fight_reward is the offline runtime mapping, not proven original policy.
Event condition kinds 3/4/8/52/100/102 are server-side; the offline runtime mapping is cited only to explain the literal values.

citation_method: Each citation points at the decompiled source row line or the client logic line. Data values come from the pinned .marshal tables; the cited .py rows were cross-checked against those pins during authoring and the file sha256 is recorded with every citation.

clues.clue_des: 抽屉中找到的一把锤子，是之前的物主留下的吗，先拿着吧或许可以做点什么。
交界都市的城市地图，被反复折叠使用过。上面有几个地方都标注了符号，但似乎在后来又被划掉，增加了新的标点。
紧闭的门扉，似乎从里边被卡住了。门上印刻着熟悉的符文。
从翻倒的垃圾桶里捡出来的纸团，散发着奇怪的腐臭味道。展开后纸上面写着一长串意味不明的数字。
不明液体干涸后的痕迹。看样是从另外一间屋子里渗出来的。
